title: Stress Free | KEY.co
description_expanded: The home’s thoughtful design extends to the private sanctuaries of its bedrooms, each boasting king-sized beds and ensuite bathrooms, with the master suites offering luxuries such as a soaking tub and screened balcony with a swinging daybed. A second-floor coffee bar adds a touch of convenience to your morning routine, while the third floor unveils a realm designed for entertainment with a living space, ping pong table, and card table. Even the carriage house, connected via a covered walkway, mirrors the main house’s elegance with its own living and kitchen area. Outdoors, the splendor continues with a stunning pool area complete with an outdoor kitchen and wood-burning fireplace, crafting the perfect backdrop for memorable evenings under the stars. This exquisite home promises not just a stay, but an unforgettable experience enveloped in luxury and charm. Discover a luxurious retreat where meticulous attention to detail and lavish comforts converge at this WaterColor cottage, freshly constructed to ensure a sumptuous vacation experience. Stepping inside, you are immediately greeted by an array of handpicked details, from the majestic concrete range hood in the chef’s dream kitchen, complete with a six-burner gas stove and dual dishwashers, to the elegant oyster shell chandelier illuminating the spacious dining area. The open-plan first floor seamlessly blends the kitchen with the dining and living areas, where plush furniture and a large-screen TV await to host family gatherings, game nights, or cozy movie evenings. Sliding glass doors reveal a screened-in back porch overlooking the private pool—an idyllic setting for afternoons filled with laughter and relaxation.
